# Find the country with the most total medals
max_total = df.loc[df['Nation'] != 'Total', 'Total'].max()
most_country = df.loc[df['Total'] == max_total, 'Nation'].iloc[0]

# Find the country with the least total medals (excluding the 'Total' row)
min_total = df.loc[df['Nation'] != 'Total', 'Total'].min()
least_country = df.loc[df['Total'] == min_total, 'Nation'].iloc[0]

# Calculate the difference in total medals between these two countries
most_total = df.loc[df['Nation'] == most_country, 'Total'].iloc[0]
least_total = df.loc[df['Nation'] == least_country, 'Total'].iloc[0]
answer = most_total - least_total
